Job Description
A growing organization in the Greater Boston area is seeking a Data Scientist to join a team focused on building and deploying advanced AI and machine learning solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge initiatives involving large language models, agentic AI workflows, and production-scale machine learning systems. 
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in machine learning, applied AI, and MLOps, with hands-on experience developing, deploying, and monitoring models in production environments. Experience within the insurance industry is highly preferred, as this position will support projects that leverage data and AI to improve business processes, decision-making, and customer experiences.
